question:
**Select the appropriate option to replace the underlined word with the adverb of frequency.**

He __did not admit__ that his team played badly.
solution:
The correct answer is **"never admitted"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to replace the underlined word with the adverb of frequency is** 'never admitted.'**
 
• Adverbs that change or qualify the meaning of a sentence by telling us how often or how frequently something happens are defined as** adverbs of frequency.**
 
• An adverb of frequency is exactly what it sounds like an adverb of time.
 
• Adverbs of frequency always describe how often something occurs, either in **definite** or **indefinite **terms.
